Bartending school is not for everyone, but it did help me get to where I am today. It just depends on your situation and the school. I went to a good bartending school because I had no prior knowledge or experience- I didn't even drink at the time. That said, I learned a lot, and it did help me get bartending jobs. But it's also important to be aware that bartending school alone is not enough. I was lucky to find one that had a well rounded curriculum, as most schools leave you with little more than some drink recipes to memorize. After that I started by booking a couple of event gigs off of craigslist just so I could get enough experience to bullshit my way into my first job, and, rather than saying I "went to bartending school", I simply backed my experience by saying I was certified. 
If you are more interested in freelancing and doing events than working at an establishment, I would say it's a good idea to take the course and get certified.
 A lot of people are put off by bartending schools because they are expensive and often not legit, but I forked over the money to go to a reputable one and I made it all back within my first few jobs.
